note: A pattern: on a String field, on a list of Strings, and on a one-field value object holds at the aggregate, one level down, two levels down, three levels down and in list members. An anchored pattern refuses a prefix, a suffix and a trailing newline; an unanchored one matches inside the value; a non-String under a pattern is a type mismatch. The same values are held to the mint audit's answers by spec/rust_host_reference_validate_conformance_spec.rb. The optional slots a value leaves out are echoed absent by Ruby and as null by a Rust record, so this fixture is compared with the null-valued keys dropped from both sides, and nothing else is loosened.
